data.title: 喜多郁代 · 晨曦微跃的粉晕私语
data.action: 盘腿坐在毛绒地毯上，双手环抱着一只小熊抱枕掩在胸前，微红着脸颊抬眼，阳光跳跃在红发马尾碎梢间，神情羞怯又透着喜悦。
data.location: 温馨明亮的少女卧室，木吉他斜倚在墙角，米白羊毛地毯上散落着乐谱
data.lighting: 金灿灿的初升朝阳洒满房间，透光窗帘滤出温暖柔和的金色尘晕
data.mood: 元气少女的羞涩清晨，明亮治愈且甜美可人
data.description: 温馨明亮的少女卧室，木吉他斜倚在墙角，米白羊毛地毯上散落着乐谱。盘腿坐在毛绒地毯上，双手环抱着一只小熊抱枕掩在胸前，微红着脸颊抬眼，阳光跳跃在红发马尾碎梢间，神情羞怯又透着喜悦。 她微微抬眸轻语——“呜……突然进门也不敲一下！虽然、虽然这套睡衣是精心挑的，但还是会害羞的啦！”
data.promptProse: In a bright morning bedroom where warm sunbeams fall across scattered sheet music and an acoustic guitar propped against the wall, Kita sits on the cream carpet peeking bashfully over a plush bear pillow with a happy blush.
data.animaCaption: Sitting cross-legged on her sunlit wool bedroom carpet beside scattered sheet music and a wall-leaning acoustic guitar, she hugs a soft bear pillow shyly to her chest with rosy cheeks in her peach-pink ruffled knit camisole and scalloped boy-shorts.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a sweet peach-pink ribbed knit camisole trimmed with dainty scalloped ruffles along the neckline and hem, paired with matching ruffled sleep boy-shorts.
